sos.title: MamaAlert
sos.offline: لا توجد إشارة - تم حفظ التنبيه
sos.needPhone: Add your phone number below so we can find your record.
sos.sentDetail: Volunteers and your clinic are being notified.
sos.duplicateDetail: An alert was already sent recently. Help is already being arranged.
sos.interactionHint: If you can respond on this phone, tap below so we know you are okay — this can delay urgent family messages.
sos.networkOfflineHint: You're offline — alerts will queue until you're back online.
sos.phoneHint: Include country code. Example starts with {{dialCode}}.
sos.howItWorks: Tap SOS once to send an emergency alert. If network is weak, your alert is saved and sent automatically when signal returns.

access.intro: Sign in with the phone number on your record, register yourself if your program allows it, or open the SOS link your health worker sent you.
access.haveLink: هل لديك رابط? افتحيه على هذا الجهاز. يحتوي على رمز خاص. يمكنك أيضا طلب إعادة إرساله من العاملة الصحية.
access.phoneHelp: Use the same number you gave when you registered (include country code, e.g. {{dialCode}}). Tap continue to sign in.
access.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number with country code.
access.codeInvalid: Enter the code from your SMS.
access.sendCodeFailed: Could not send the code. Try again later.
access.verifyFailed: Invalid or expired code. Request a new code and try again.

shortLink.title: Use your full SOS link or sign in
shortLink.body: This page only has your phone number. Sign in with that number to unlock your secure SOS token, or ask your health worker to resend the complete link.
shortLink.signInCta: Sign in with this phone number

selfReg.title: التسجيل الذاتي
selfReg.subtitle: If your area allows it, you can enroll without a link from a health worker. One trusted contact will get the read-only status link by SMS when enabled on the server.
selfReg.contactRequired: أضيفي جهة اتصال واحدة على الأقل مع رقم هاتف صحيح.
selfReg.contactHint: This person can receive the secure status link during an alert (and a welcome SMS when your server enables it).
selfReg.zonesError: Could not load areas. Check your connection and try again.
selfReg.minimalHint: Only basic details. Your health worker will be notified to finish your profile.

onboarding.step1Body: This red button is only for emergencies. You will use it if you need urgent maternal help.
onboarding.step2Intro: Volunteers in your area can be notified when you send an alert.
onboarding.step2Body: Save a number we can call if volunteers need to reach you. You can change it anytime before sending an alert.
onboarding.volunteersLoading: Counting volunteers near your registered location…
onboarding.volunteersUnknown: We could not load the volunteer count right now. Help may still be available when you send an alert.
onboarding.volunteersNear: About {{n}} volunteers are within about 5 km of your registered location and may respond.
onboarding.step3Body: Tap SOS once if you need help. If you have no signal, your alert is saved and sends automatically when you are back online.

volunteer.title: لوحة المتطوع
volunteer.enterPhone: Enter the phone number you registered with.
volunteer.smsPrimary: SMS is the primary way to respond to alerts. This dashboard is optional for live updates.
volunteer.loginIntro: Sign in with the phone number you registered.

hospital.title: تنبيه وارد
hospital.markResolvedHint: Use when care is complete. Field health workers cannot close alerts from their dashboard.
hospital.portalTokenHelp: Paste the hospital portal token issued by your zone admin from the Admin dashboard hospital row.

register.title: تسجيل مريضة
register.locationRequired: Capture your current location before submitting.

family.title: حالة MamaAlert
family.notFound: لم نتمكن من تحميل صفحة الحالة.

admin.title: مسؤول المنطقة
admin.mapLegend: Red: patients · Green: volunteers · Blue: hospitals · Large red: active alerts
admin.noZoneForSettings: Your admin account has no zone; escalation and team tools are unavailable.
admin.escalationHint: Leave a field unchanged to keep the current value. Clear a number and save to use the server default. Radii: 5–50 km. Delay: at least 30 seconds.
admin.escalationKmRange: Each radius must be between 5 and 50 km.
admin.escalationDelayMin: Delay must be at least 30 seconds.
admin.inviteHelp: Supabase sends a welcome email with a secure link to open /register, set a password, and access the worker dashboard.
admin.tokenCopyManual: Token created — automatic copy failed (use HTTPS or allow clipboard access). Copy it from the dialog below.

demo.title: عرض تجريبي
demo.step1: Step 1: Patient Priya triggers SOS from the MamaAlert home screen.
demo.step2: Step 2: SMS goes to volunteers within 5 km.
demo.step3: Step 3: Ravi replies YES by SMS or the volunteer dashboard.
demo.step4: Step 4: Priya gets a confirmation SMS.
demo.step5: Step 5: PHC Demo Clinic receives a pre-alert.
demo.step6: Step 6: Family opens the secure status link.
demo.seedHint: Uses seed patient phone {{phone}} (Supabase seed + API must be running).
demo.missingToken: Set VITE_DEMO_SOS_TOKEN in client .env to the sos_token from registering a demo patient.
demo.tokenHint: Demo SOS requires VITE_DEMO_SOS_TOKEN from the worker patient registration response.

a11y.sosAnnouncementSent: المساعدة في الطريق. يتم إشعار المتطوعين وعيادتك.
a11y.sosAnnouncementOffline: لا يوجد إشارة. تم حفظ تنبيهك وسيُرسل عند عودة الاتصال.
a11y.sosAnnouncementError: تعذر إرسال التنبيه. حاول مرة أخرى.
a11y.sosAnnouncementDuplicate: تم إرسال تنبيه مؤخرًا. جارٍ ترتيب المساعدة.

worker.title: Health worker hub
worker.healthWorkerOnly: This page is for field health workers. Zone admins should use Admin.
worker.noZoneVolunteers: No zone assigned — volunteer list unavailable.
worker.noPatients: No patients assigned to you yet.

volunteerReg.title: Register a volunteer
volunteerReg.welcomeSmsHint: They will receive a welcome SMS. Emergency alerts always go by SMS; the web app is optional.
volunteerReg.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number (at least 8 digits).
volunteerReg.villageRequired: Enter the volunteer’s village or home area.

worker.completeProfileDesc: Add village, at least one emergency contact, and optionally update map location.
worker.draftSaved: Draft saved on this device until the server confirms it.
worker.draftKept: Your draft is still saved on this device.

network.offlineLiveData: أنت غير متصلة. التحديثات المباشرة تحتاج إلى إنترنت.
network.offlineSmsAlertsHint: SMS still works on cellular: reply YES or NO to alert texts; pre-alerts and ARRIVED use SMS too.
network.offlineCannotSubmit: أنت غير متصلة. حفظ هذا النموذج يحتاج إلى إنترنت.
network.offlineStatusPage: أنت غير متصلة. لا يمكن تحميل حالة جديدة حتى يعود الاتصال.
